desc.en: ALEXIA EXPORTS connects international buyers with carefully sourced agricultural, food and mineral products from Egypt and beyond. Request a tailored quote.
desc.ar: ألكسيا للتصدير تربط المشترين الدوليين بمنتجات زراعية وغذائية ومعدنية مختارة بعناية من مصر وخارجها. اطلب عرض سعر مخصصًا.
desc.fr: ALEXIA EXPORTS met en relation des acheteurs internationaux avec des produits agricoles, alimentaires et minéraux soigneusement sélectionnés en Égypte et au-delà. Demandez un devis sur mesure.
desc.es: ALEXIA EXPORTS conecta a compradores internacionales con productos agrícolas, alimentarios y minerales cuidadosamente seleccionados en Egipto y más allá. Solicite una cotización a medida.

lede.en: ALEXIA EXPORTS connects international buyers with carefully sourced agricultural, food and mineral products from Egypt and beyond, with clear communication, tailored specifications and export-focused service.
lede.ar: ألكسيا للتصدير تربط المشترين الدوليين بمنتجات زراعية وغذائية ومعدنية مختارة بعناية من مصر وخارجها، مع تواصل واضح ومواصفات مخصصة وخدمة موجهة للتصدير.
lede.fr: ALEXIA EXPORTS met en relation des acheteurs internationaux avec des produits agricoles, alimentaires et minéraux soigneusement sélectionnés en Égypte et au-delà, avec une communication claire, des spécifications sur mesure et un service tourné vers l'export.
lede.es: ALEXIA EXPORTS conecta a compradores internacionales con productos agrícolas, alimentarios y minerales cuidadosamente seleccionados en Egipto y más allá, con una comunicación clara, especificaciones a medida y un servicio orientado a la exportación.

q.en: What should I include in an enquiry?
q.fr: Que dois-je indiquer dans une demande ?

a.en: Product name, destination country, estimated quantity and packaging preference. A preferred trade term and any specification help us respond faster.
a.ar: اسم المنتج وبلد الوجهة والكمية التقديرية وتفضيل التعبئة. ويساعدنا شرط التجارة المفضل وأي مواصفات على الرد بشكل أسرع.
a.fr: Le nom du produit, le pays de destination, la quantité estimée et le conditionnement souhaité. Un Incoterm préféré et toute spécification nous aident à répondre plus vite.
a.es: El nombre del producto, el país de destino, la cantidad estimada y el envase preferido. Un término comercial preferido y cualquier especificación nos ayudan a responder más rápido.

a.en: Yes. Varieties, grades, packaging, order quantities and availability can be tailored to your market and purchase requirements, subject to availability.
a.ar: نعم. يمكن تخصيص الأصناف والدرجات والتعبئة وكميات الطلب والتوفر بما يناسب سوقك ومتطلبات الشراء، حسب التوفر.
a.fr: Oui. Les variétés, calibres, conditionnements, quantités et disponibilités peuvent être adaptés à votre marché et à vos besoins d'achat, selon la disponibilité.
a.es: Sí. Las variedades, calibres, envases, cantidades de pedido y disponibilidad pueden adaptarse a su mercado y a sus necesidades de compra, según disponibilidad.

q.en: What is the minimum order quantity?
q.fr: Quelle est la quantité minimale de commande ?
q.es: ¿Cuál es la cantidad mínima de pedido?

a.en: It depends on the product, packaging and shipping method, so we confirm it for each enquiry.
a.ar: يعتمد على المنتج والتعبئة وطريقة الشحن، لذلك نؤكده لكل استفسار.
a.fr: Elle dépend du produit, du conditionnement et du mode d'expédition ; nous la confirmons donc pour chaque demande.
a.es: Depende del producto, del envase y del método de envío, por lo que la confirmamos en cada consulta.

a.en: Documents are prepared for the specific order. The set depends on the product and destination, so tell us your import requirements early.
a.ar: تُعدّ المستندات للطلب المحدد. وتعتمد المجموعة على المنتج والوجهة، لذا أخبرنا بمتطلبات الاستيراد لديك مبكرًا.
a.fr: Les documents sont préparés pour chaque commande. Le dossier dépend du produit et de la destination ; indiquez-nous donc tôt vos exigences d'importation.
a.es: Los documentos se preparan para cada pedido. El conjunto depende del producto y del destino, así que cuéntenos pronto sus requisitos de importación.

a.en: EXW, FOB, CFR and CIF, or leave it open and we will advise on the best fit.
a.ar: EXW وFOB وCFR وCIF، أو اتركه مفتوحًا وسننصحك بالأنسب.
a.fr: EXW, FOB, CFR et CIF, ou laissez le choix ouvert et nous vous conseillerons la meilleure option.
a.es: EXW, FOB, CFR y CIF, o déjelo abierto y le aconsejaremos la mejor opción.

q.ar: هل تتعاملون مع مشترين حول العالم؟
q.fr: Travaillez-vous avec des acheteurs du monde entier ?
q.es: ¿Trabajan con compradores de todo el mundo?

a.en: We work with international buyers. We confirm shipping options for each destination when we prepare your proposal.

text.en: We support international buyers seeking dependable access to agricultural, food and mineral products. Our approach begins with understanding your specifications, market, packaging preferences and shipment requirements, then coordinating a suitable supply proposal.

title.en: Ex Works

text.en: The seller makes the goods available at its premises. The buyer arranges export clearance, transport, freight and everything after.
text.ar: يتيح البائع البضاعة في مقره. ويتولى المشتري التخليص التصديري والنقل والشحن وكل ما بعده.
text.fr: Le vendeur met la marchandise à disposition dans ses locaux. L'acheteur organise le dédouanement à l'export, le transport, le fret et tout ce qui suit.
text.es: El vendedor pone la mercancía a disposición en sus instalaciones. El comprador se encarga del despacho de exportación, el transporte, el flete y todo lo que sigue.

title.en: Free On Board

text.en: The seller clears the goods for export and loads them on the vessel at the port of shipment. The buyer arranges freight and everything after.
text.ar: يخلّص البائع البضاعة للتصدير ويحمّلها على السفينة في ميناء الشحن. ويتولى المشتري الشحن وكل ما بعده.
text.fr: Le vendeur dédouane la marchandise à l'export et la charge sur le navire au port d'embarquement. L'acheteur organise le fret et tout ce qui suit.
text.es: El vendedor despacha la mercancía para la exportación y la carga en el buque en el puerto de embarque. El comprador se encarga del flete y de todo lo que sigue.

title.en: Cost and Freight

text.en: The seller pays the sea freight to the destination port. Risk passes to the buyer once the goods are loaded on the vessel.
text.ar: يدفع البائع أجرة الشحن البحري حتى ميناء الوصول. وتنتقل المخاطر إلى المشتري عند تحميل البضاعة على السفينة.
text.fr: Le vendeur paie le fret maritime jusqu'au port de destination. Le risque est transféré à l'acheteur une fois la marchandise chargée sur le navire.
text.es: El vendedor paga el flete marítimo hasta el puerto de destino. El riesgo pasa al comprador cuando la mercancía está cargada en el buque.

title.en: Cost, Insurance and Freight

text.en: As CFR, with the seller also arranging minimum insurance to the destination port. Risk still passes to the buyer at loading.
text.ar: مثل CFR، ويرتب البائع أيضًا الحد الأدنى من التأمين حتى ميناء الوصول. وتنتقل المخاطر إلى المشتري عند التحميل.
text.fr: Comme CFR, le vendeur souscrivant en plus une assurance minimale jusqu'au port de destination. Le risque est transféré à l'acheteur au chargement.
text.es: Como CFR, y además el vendedor contrata un seguro mínimo hasta el puerto de destino. El riesgo sigue pasando al comprador en la carga.

title.en: About ALEXIA EXPORTS

intro.en: ALEXIA EXPORTS is an Egypt-based export company that helps international buyers source agricultural, food and mineral products.

desc.en: About ALEXIA EXPORTS, an Egyptian export company supplying agricultural, food and mineral products to importers, distributors and manufacturers worldwide.

p.en:
We support importers, distributors, packers and food manufacturers who want dependable access to Egyptian agricultural and food products. We start from your specification, target market and shipment requirements, then coordinate a supply proposal with partner producers and factories.

Our [product range](page:products) covers fresh produce, frozen fruit, dry legumes, edible oils, dates, processed foods, salt and food ingredients.

Every enquiry is handled the same way:

- **Buyer-led sourcing:** your requirements guide the proposal.
- **Clear specifications:** product, grade and pack are aligned before you commit.
- **Export coordination:** documents and logistics are planned with you, following the trade term you choose.

Read the full [export process](page:export-process) and our approach to [quality control](page:quality-control).

Egypt combines long growing seasons, Mediterranean and Red Sea ports and a broad agricultural base. That makes it a practical origin for buyers in Europe, the Gulf, North Africa and Asia. See the [markets we plan shipments for](page:export-markets).
Tell us the product, destination country and estimated quantity. We reply with the available options, packing choices and commercial terms.

title.en: Egyptian Food Products for Export | ALEXIA EXPORTS
Product Specifications for Egyptian Export Orders

intro.en: Specifications are agreed with the buyer before an order. This page explains what is typically defined and how to request documents.

desc.en: What buyers define in an export specification for Egyptian fresh, frozen and dry products, and how to request a TDS and COA from ALEXIA EXPORTS.

p.en: A written specification keeps the buyer, the supplier and the inspector working to the same definition of the product. It reduces disputes at the port and speeds up approval of the shipment.

- **Fresh produce:** variety, size or calibre, grade, colour, packing type and net weight, target shelf life.
- **Dry legumes and rice:** size (for example in mm), moisture, foreign matter, damaged or split grains, colour and bag size.
- **Frozen products:** IQF or block, size, defects, pack size and storage temperature.
- **Oils and processed foods:** type, container size, labelling and shelf life.

These are typical buying parameters, not published values. Confirmed values are added to each product page, for example [dry chickpeas](product:chickpeas) or [frozen fruit](product:frozen).

h.en: Technical data sheets and certificates of analysis

p.en: A Technical Data Sheet (TDS) describes the product. A Certificate of Analysis (COA) reports test results for a specific lot. Ask for the documents relevant to your product when you send your enquiry, and see [quality control](page:quality-control) for the wider document list.
Send the product, destination and the parameters that matter to you. We will confirm what can be supplied and in which packaging, see [packaging options](page:packaging-options).

title.en: Product Specifications for Egyptian Food Exports
Packaging Options for Egyptian Food Exports

intro.en: Cartons, crates, bags, pouches and bulk packs: the packing is chosen to suit the product and your market.

desc.en: Packaging options for Egyptian food exports from ALEXIA EXPORTS: cartons, crates, bags, retail pouches and bulk packs for fresh, frozen and dry goods.

p.en: The right pack depends on the product, the sales channel and the transport. Retail, food-service and bulk or industrial formats are all possible, and buyer specifications can be discussed.

- **Fresh fruit and vegetables:** strong cartons and ventilated plastic crates, for example [citrus](product:citrus) and [grapes](product:grapes).
- **Dry legumes and rice:** export bags such as 25 kg and smaller retail pouches, see [chickpeas](product:chickpeas), [white kidney beans](product:white-kidney-beans) and [rice](product:rice).
- **Frozen berries:** retail bags and larger cartons for manufacturers, see [frozen fruits](product:frozen).
- **Oils and canned foods:** bottles, tins and cartons, see [edible oils](product:oils) and [processed foods](product:processed).

Goods are normally palletised and loaded into containers. Fresh and frozen products ship in temperature-controlled (reefer) containers, dry goods in standard containers. Loading plans follow the trade term you select, see [export process](page:export-process).
Labelling and marking can be aligned with the rules of the destination market. Tell us the market when you ask for a quote, and review [export markets](page:export-markets).

intro.en: ALEXIA EXPORTS plans shipments from Egypt for buyers in Europe, the United Kingdom, the Gulf states, North Africa and Asia.

desc.en: Export markets served from Egypt by ALEXIA EXPORTS: Europe, the UK, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, North Africa and Asia.

p.en: Importers in Europe and the UK usually ask for clear specifications, traceability and documents that match import rules. We prepare the documents with you, see [quality control](page:quality-control). Popular enquiries include [oranges](product:citrus), [frozen berries](product:frozen) and [dry legumes](product:ingr-2).

h.en: Gulf: UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait and Oman

p.en: Gulf buyers often source rice, legumes, dates, oils and fresh produce. Halal documentation is commonly requested; tell us at enquiry stage so we can confirm which partner can supply it. See [rice](product:rice), [dates](product:dates) and [edible oils](product:oils).
Egypt's position makes shorter sea routes possible to neighbouring North African markets. Packaging and labelling can be adapted to each destination.

Long-haul sea freight needs careful packing and the right container type. We plan temperature control for fresh and frozen goods and agree the trade term early, see [incoterms for food exports](page:incoterms-for-food-exports).
Quotes are prepared per destination, product and quantity. Start from the [export process](page:export-process) or send an enquiry directly.

Incoterms for Food Exports: EXW, FOB, CFR and CIF Explained

intro.en: A plain-language comparison of the four trade terms most used for food shipments from Egypt.

desc.en: Incoterms for food exports explained: how EXW, FOB, CFR and CIF divide cost and risk between buyer and seller in Egyptian food shipments.

p.en: The trade term decides who arranges and pays for transport and export or import clearance, and where risk passes from seller to buyer. Choose it before you compare prices, because offers on different terms are not comparable.

- **EXW (Ex Works):** the goods are made available at the seller's premises. The buyer arranges everything after that.
- **FOB (Free On Board):** the seller clears the goods for export and loads them on the vessel. The buyer pays the main freight.
- **CFR (Cost and Freight):** the seller also pays the sea freight to the destination port. Risk still passes at loading.
- **CIF (Cost, Insurance and Freight):** as CFR, plus the seller buys minimum insurance.

Buyers with their own forwarder often prefer FOB. Buyers who want one delivered-to-port price choose CFR or CIF. Tell us your preference in the enquiry, or ask us to advise. See the [export process](page:export-process) and [export markets](page:export-markets).
